scope: Trend and pairwise tests for the claim that the automatic stale-label's precision is capability-graded.

pooled_precision.status: SUPPORTED -- this is the result the paper should lead with

verdict.what_to_report: The pooled precision is the supported result: the automatic grounded_outdated label is right 33% of the time (Wilson [0.2445, 0.4358]), so roughly two thirds of items it flags are not superseded facts. The apparent ordering across model sizes is exploratory: the exact trend test gives p=0.081 and the extreme-pair Fisher test p=0.071, and detecting a difference of the observed size at 80% power would need about 71 adjudicated items per model against the 30 we have.
